messages:
Alex: Quick check 2d proposal to add optional top-level field `streaming_meta` in chat/completions streaming deltas to surface partial-state attrs (is_final, chunk_id, model_latency_est). Will this be backward-compatible with SDKs that parse message objects?

Alex: Example delta we'd emit for streaming:
```
{
  "role": "assistant",
  "content": "Here is a partial sentence...",
  "streaming_meta": { "chunk_id": "c-42", "is_final": false, "model_latency_ms": 12 }
}
```

Maria: Quick thought 2d most of our SDKs accept extra fields today (JS tolerant, Go decode into map). Python dataclasses in the SDK are strict if typed; we have a parsing layer that errors on unknown fields unless we enable allow_extra. @Jordan any runtime guarantees? :thinking:

Jordan: Runtime note: we only add streaming_meta to "delta"/stream events. Non-streaming responses won't include it. We'll make it optional so older clients ignore it. Also we'll avoid adding it to tool-call outputs unless explicitly enabled.

Maria: Ok good. Can we avoid changing top-level schema shape? Append optional field is fine. Suggest `streaming_meta` (no v suffix) and document it as experimental.

Alex: Also need to decide: do we attach meta to assistant messages only or also to function/tool messages? I worry about consumers that rely on message.role to route.

Jordan: Plan: assistant deltas get streaming_meta. Tool invocations will get a separate `tool_meta` when we need per-chunk info. That keeps consumer logic simpler.

dev-bot: deploy-bot: rolling canary pushed to staging with schema flag `streaming_meta=true` 2d 3 of 5 nodes.

Sam: I'll add an e2e in eng-runtime that verifies unknown-field tolerance + that the SDK roundtrip ignores streaming_meta by default.

Maria: I'll open SDK PR adding an opt-in rawDelta flag and a changelog note. We should also add a migration checklist for enterprise customers (Dedicated/Private) in case they run strict parsers.

Alex: Perfect. Owners: Jordan (runtime change), Maria (SDK PR + docs), Sam (tests). If no objections I'll file the feature RFC and schedule the canary -> prod rollout next week. :thumbsup:

Jordan: No objections. +1 from runtime.

Maria: +1

Sam: +1

Alex: Thanks 2d will file RFC and link here.
